judged_text: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim into the new table while EmbeddableHost.record_for_host matches `lower(host)` against the bare parsed hostname, so legacy entries stored as 'http://eviltrout.com' or 'https://example.com/1234' — forms the old feature's own specs explicitly supported — never match after the upgrade (the model's stripping only runs on save, and the migration bypasses the model). Upgraded sites whose admins entered scheme- or path-qualified hosts get 'invalid referer host' Discourse::InvalidAccess on every embedded comment page and rejected feed imports, silently, until an admin re-saves each row in the new UI.
